name: Préparateur des moules
description: Short stocky adult with very thick forearms, broad neck and shoulder-length thick dreadlocks. FULL rounded bronze-black protective Yautja mask conceals mouth and face, a wide domed brow and central vertical grill with two short cheek vents, distinctly different mask from reference.
